=== ARQUIVO 1: .github/workflows/instalar.yml ===
name: Instalar projeto
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths: ['projeto.zip']
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  instalar:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: |
          unzip -q -o projeto.zip
          rm projeto.zip
          git config user.name github-actions
          git config user.email github-actions@users.noreply.github.com
          git add -A
          git commit -m "Adiciona arquivos do projeto"
          git push

=== ARQUIVO 2: .github/workflows/deploy.yml ===
name: Publicar site (GitHub Pages)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm run build
        env:
          VITE_BASE: /${{ github.event.repository.name }}/
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

=== ARQUIVO 3: .github/workflows/apk.yml ===
name: Gerar APK (Android)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21

      - run: npm install
      - run: npm run build
        env:
          VITE_BASE: ./

      - name: Instalar Capacitor 7 e ferramenta de ícones
        run: npm install @capacitor/core@7 @capacitor/cli@7 @capacitor/android@7 @capacitor/assets@3 --no-save

      - name: Criar projeto Android
        run: npx cap add android

      - name: Gerar ícones a partir de assets/
        run: npx capacitor-assets generate --android

      - name: Sincronizar
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Compilar APK
        working-directory: android
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug

      - name: Publicar em Releases
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk hydra-player.apk
          gh release create "apk-${{ github.run_number }}" hydra-player.apk \
            --title "Hydra Player APK #${{ github.run_number }}" \
            --notes "APK de teste para Android (assinado com chave de debug)."
